datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule (January, April, July, October 2012) across South Sudan administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases and scenarios, spatially encoded as geographic features with attributes including classification scale, collection date, and assistance eligibility status. This dataset provides post-event/current-state impact assessments of food insecurity conditions.
